description: This PHP source file defines the LDAPConfigAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for configuring LDAP settings within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes methods to retrieve and update LDAP configuration, validate parameters, and interact with LDAP setting models.

classes.name: LDAPConfigAPI
classes.description: A class that handles LDAP configuration API endpoints, including retrieval and update of LDAP settings, validation, and interaction with LDAP configuration models.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT requests to update LDAP configuration settings using data provided in the request body, including validation and setting of LDAPAttribute model properties.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve the current LDAP configuration settings.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the update operation, excluding the ID parameter.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; throws an exception indicating delete operation is not supported.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a single LDAP configuration, excluding the ID parameter.

methods.name: setConfigAttributes
methods.description: Sets LDAP configuration attributes such as bind credentials, enable flag, sync interval, and merge flag based on request parameters.

methods.name: setDataMappingAttributes
methods.description: Assigns data mapping attribute names to the LDAP setting object.

methods.name: setUserLookupSettings
methods.description: Associates user lookup settings objects with the LDAP setting based on provided array data.
